:::{#exr-linear-map-matrix-practice}
#### Evaluating a linear map from its values on the indicator vectors

By @thm-linear-map-matrix,
the values of a [linear map](#def-linear-map) at the [indicator vectors](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-indicator-vector) determine it everywhere.
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals^2$ be a linear map with

$$
f(\vecf{e}_1) = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
f(\vecf{e}_2) = \begin{bmatrix} -2 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Find $f\paren{\begin{bmatrix} 4 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Build the [matrix of $f$](#def-matrix-of-linear-map) from the two given values,
then multiply.

:::

:::
